_help: Copy everything inside the { } of "scenario" below and paste it into the list in scenarios-en.json (add a comma after the previous scenario). Keep ids short, lowercase, with dashes, and unique. Impacts are -2 (harms the principle) to +2 (strengthens it); leave a principle out if it is not affected. Principles: humanity, impartiality, neutrality, independence, doNoHarm. Energy and environmental costs count under doNoHarm. 'colors' is optional: two hex colours for the card. 'discuss' is optional: questions for a workshop of this scenario; leave it out to use the shared questions.
